tasks.title: Rewrite multi-agent-subagent.txt: D1 delivery contract + D7 mirror sentence + D4-style framing
tasks.description: Replace the 'Final answer' section (current lines 35-37) with a 'Delivery contract' section that literally states the tool-call sequence (send_message(target: spawner, message: <result>), then in a SEPARATE next step close_agent). Bake in a canonical-path reminder pointing at the per-spawn D2 injection. Mirror one sentence on send_message unicast doctrine (D7-mirror). Preserve existing 'Your context', 'You can spawn too', 'Cross-agent messaging', 'Closing yourself' sections.

tasks.title: Extend multi-agent-root.txt: D7 sibling coordination section + D8 limits-of-actor-model section
tasks.description: Add 'Sibling coordination' section (D7): unicast doctrine ('send_message and followup_task are unicast — only the addressed target receives; there is no broadcast'), three working patterns (CC: address one recipient and CC others by explicit per-target sends; Coordinator: spawn a coordinator subagent that fans out, drains, integrates, sends ONE consolidated message back; followup_task chain: assign next-step to one agent at a time), anti-pattern (do not wait_agent for a message routed to a different sibling — it will never arrive). Add 'Limits' section (D8): no broadcast primitive, no sibling introspection (cannot read a peer's mailbox or in-flight tool calls), no deadlock detection (the runtime will not break a wait cycle for you), idle ≠ alive (an agent at a wait_agent is alive but not making progress; close it if you are done). Preserve all existing sections.

tasks.title: Add INV-D-06 + INV-D-08 to test/integration/multi-agent-invariants.test.ts
tasks.description: Append two new it.instance tests using testEffect / it.instance pattern per test/AGENTS.md. INV-D-06 ('send-message-is-unicast-not-broadcast'): spawn /root/alice and /root/bob from root; root send_message(target: /root/alice, message: 'for alice only'); assert bob's mailbox is empty AND alice's mailbox contains the message. INV-D-08 ('coordinator-fan-out-delivers-single-consolidated-message'): spawn coordinator; coordinator spawns 2 grandchildren in one message (two spawn_agent calls); grandchildren each send_message(coordinator, partial); each self-closes; coordinator drains, integrates, sends ONE consolidated send_message(root, integrated); coordinator self-closes; assert root's mailbox has exactly ONE message from coordinator AND the integrated body contains both grandchildren's content. Test slug strings MUST match exactly: 'send-message-is-unicast-not-broadcast', 'coordinator-fan-out-delivers-single-consolidated-message'.
